name: vector_only_baseline
observations: All answerable questions retrieved at least one expected evidence page in the top 5.
The participant-count question retrieved relevant pages but generated 77 instead of the expected 85.
The unanswerable medication question did not trigger abstention.
Cosine distance alone cannot separate answerable from unanswerable questions.
The participant-count question had a best distance of 0.6240 while the unanswerable medication question had a best distance of 0.6219.
